title: Request GitHub Enterprise Cloud's current SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter
description: Through the GitHub Enterprise account (account manager or GitHub's Enterprise trust portal, under the existing NDA), ask for the SOC 2 Type II report covering the period after 2025-09-30 for GitHub Enterprise Cloud. If the new report is not yet issued, ask for a signed bridge letter covering 2025-10-01 to the date of the request. Ask that scope explicitly include source hosting, GitHub Actions and GitHub Packages, the three services example-co uses. Send the request no later than 2026-09-25 so the evidence arrives before the current report expires on 2026-09-30. Store the document in the company's GRC document store, not in this workspace. This is a documentary change, so no deployment window or change freeze from sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess applies.
acceptanceCriteria: A dated written request to GitHub for the post-2025-09-30 SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter) exists in the GRC store, sent on or before 2026-09-25
The report or bridge letter received from GitHub names GitHub Enterprise Cloud in scope, and its period starts no later than 2025-10-01
The task evidence holds a locator to the received document (GRC store reference and document date), with no copy of the report in the workspace

verificationMethod.description: The CISO opens the GRC store locator in the task evidence and confirms three things: the document is a SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter issued by the service auditor or GitHub; its subject is GitHub Enterprise Cloud; and its coverage period starts on or before 2025-10-01, leaving no gap after the expiring report.

rootCause.description: GitHub's public trust center and security pages publish no report periods or dates, so the renewal was never pushed to example-co. The only evidence on file is the 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 report, expiring 2026-09-30.
